# zclone completion powershell

Output powershell completion script for zclone.

## Synopsis

Generate the autocompletion script for powershell.

To load completions in your current shell session:

```console
zclone completion powershell | Out-String | Invoke-Expression
```

To load completions for every new session, add the output of the above command
to your powershell profile.

If output_file is "-" or missing, then the output will be written to stdout.

```
zclone completion powershell [output_file] [flags]
```

## Options

```
  -h, --help   help for powershell
```

See the [global flags page](/flags/) for global options not listed here.
